create_experiment.description: Register a new experiment in a project. Use this to record eval results you log yourself. To have Braintrust run an eval for you, use Launch evaluation instead.
create_experiment.name: create_experiment

parameters.description: The project the experiment belongs to.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: A name for the experiment. Leave blank to have Braintrust generate one.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: An optional description of the experiment.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: An optional dataset to link to the experiment for reproducibility.
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.description: By default, reusing an existing name returns that experiment. Turn this on to always create a fresh one with a unique name instead.
parameters.name: ensure_new

parameters.description: Turn on to make the experiment viewable by anyone with the link, inside or outside your organization.
parameters.name: public

project_id.description: ID of the project the experiment is in.

launch_evaluation.description: Run an evaluation: Braintrust runs your task function over a dataset, grades each result with the scorers you pick, creates an experiment, and returns the summary.
launch_evaluation.display_str_template: Launch a Braintrust evaluation in project {project_id}.
launch_evaluation.name: launch_evaluation

parameters.description: The project to run the evaluation in.
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.description: The function to evaluate (the task being graded).
parameters.name: task_function_id

parameters.description: One or more scorers used to grade each result. Choose built-in scorers or your project's own scoring functions.
parameters.name: score_function_ids

parameters.description: A name for the experiment this eval creates. Leave blank to have Braintrust generate one.
parameters.name: experiment_name

experiment_name.description: Name of the experiment the eval created.

experiment_url.description: Link to the experiment in Braintrust.

metrics.description: Aggregate metrics (such as duration), keyed by name.

project_url.description: Link to the project in Braintrust.

scores.description: Average score for each scorer, keyed by scorer name.

description: Run and record AI evaluations in Braintrust: create experiments and launch evals over your datasets, tasks, and scorers.
